subject: P3h — ISO 15924 script codes + CLDR locale data ingest
description: ISO 15924 (/vault/Data/Unicode/iso15924/) — script identity codes tied to Unicode "sc"/"scx" attributes. CLDR (/vault/Data/Unicode/Public/cldr/ + /vault/Data/Unicode/cldr/) — locale data linking language ↔ script ↔ region ↔ calendar ↔ number format. Both attest on substrate's language_name, script_name, region_name entities. Cross-source corroboration on shared codes via Glicko. Connects ISO 639 (P4) + Unicode UCD (P3b-f) + CLDR on the same content-addressed identity surface.
